description: AGSC-01-21 (registered at rc.5): the 2–5 count of the §2.2 table is the warning AGSC-E213, raised for a tags array with fewer than 2 or more than 5 values, with or without a closed vocabulary; the schema carries no minItems/maxItems for it because the bound is a warning and not an error. Derivation: one tag and six tags each warn once; two, three and five tags do not; every tag here is inside tags.allowed, so no AGSC-E203 accompanies the warning and the case isolates the count. The item is otherwise conforming, so no other finding is expected.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
